pages.text: A terminal shows the contents of every drive connected to it.$(br2)Network Cables connect blocks to the network.$(br2)Every drive has one network port, usually low on its back, and only connects there. A network is limited to 4,096 blocks.

pages.title: Using a Terminal
pages.text: Left-click an item to take a stack, right-click to take half, and shift-click to move a stack to your inventory.$(br2)To store items, click the grid while holding them (right-click will store one), or shift-click them in your inventory. The bar under the grid shows how full the cells are.$(br2)Later terminals add features. The Typewriter shows the grid only. The Uniscope adds a
search bar. The Video Terminal and Floppy Disk Terminal add a crafting grid, and the Floppy Disk Terminal has its own internal storage.
